body:
## Parent

[Specify Talli's modular monorepo architecture and migration](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/issues/121)

## Migration stage

Stage 10 — `company_tax_filing` (slice 2 of 2 and stage exit).

## What to build

Move company-tax calculations, supported-scope checks, deterministic XML, attachment requirements, owner confirmation handoff, submission, official feedback, receipts, and archive projection into the backend.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Supported company-tax cases produce outputs identical to current schema and TT02 evidence.
- [x] Participation-exemption reconciliation and attachment gates remain deterministic and fail closed.
- [x] Confirmation, submission, feedback, and receipt transitions remain authorized and idempotent.
- [x] The complete owner workflow uses FastAPI and the generated client.
- [x] Generic company-tax rows, duplicate TypeScript calculations, and active-stage compatibility code are removed.
- [x] The complete `company_tax_filing` stage exit criteria from issue #132 pass before annual-accounts migration begins.

## Blocked by

- [Migrate tax settlement](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/issues/146)

## Approved source handoff for final annual billing

[9 September 2026 owner decision](https://github.com/kristianelmer/Talli/issues/192#issuecomment-5599100453): Publish immutable company/year/obligation readiness, complete production-submission history (including completeness evidence before concluding none submitted), terminal/unknown outcomes, corrections and source-owned incident facts through public contracts for Annual Compliance and final #192. Preserve evidence identity, source version, timing, attribution and company/year. An absent source is unavailable. Billing alone applies #177 commercial classification and monetary policy; this obligation adds no billing decisions or duplicate writer to a filing owner. Existing controlled-production, genuine-company and action-time gates remain mandatory.

The relative source-stage order is unchanged. #193 still clears RF-1086, company tax and annual accounts serially. #192 implementation pauses during this source work and resumes after #149/#208; no parallel billing writer is authorized.
